explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

a:

i would define a type XXXXX:
type XXXXX = object
                   {
                       id: id,
                       name: string,
                       address: address,
                   }

and let the XXXXX objects be of type XXXXX. so in this case, you could say
XXXXX *theXXXXX = XXXXX.createdefault

you could also use the object api to create a default XXXXX that is null for any fields that are null:
XXXXX *theXXXXX = object.createdefault(XXXXX)

since XXXXX is a type, it's common to use the type name in the type name field. 
and then your XXXXX type would look like
type XXXXX = object
